"Okay."

Tang Yin’s pretty face gradually regained its color, and she rubbed her cheek against Zhao An’s arm. "It’s not tiring at all. My mom said that after she recovers for a while, she wants to have three more children for you. She said at least three.

That’s why she wanted to have three children for Zhao An, as a way to express her submission.
Zhao An didn’t care. If the woman wanted to have children, so be it.
He didn’t care how many children the woman gave him. They could have children if they wanted, or they could use an IUD to prevent pregnancy.

Zhao An bit Tang Yin’s ear, a lewd smile playing on his lips.
"Mmm... I’m waiting for you!"
Tang Yin’s eyes welled up with tears. She didn’t regret being with Zhao An.
Marriage was just a formality. In the world of the wealthy, which man didn’t have affairs? Where was the sincerity in that?
At least Zhao An never hid it, and he wasn’t fickle.

He could satisfy her material needs, fulfill her sexual desires, and she’d have a child with him.
She wouldn’t have to worry about being alone in the future; Tang Yin knew Zhao An wasn’t a heartless man.

As for marriage, Tang Yin had no intention of doing so.
Perhaps men never get married, and a woman with that ability hadn’t appeared yet.
No woman could tolerate her man having a bunch of mistresses.
And these mistresses even had children.
What was going on? If things aren’t handled well later, it could very well lead to a family split!
Tang Yin was well aware of this, so she hadn’t even considered it.
Even her mother, Qian Yuling, didn’t have such thoughts; her mother, however, possessed the means and the courage.
But age was a major disadvantage.
She had no interest in it either. As long as she held power in the group, no matter who became the first wife, they wouldn’t ignore her.
Having figured this out, Tang Yin became quite indifferent.
Having given birth, she had come to terms with everything.
It didn’t matter anymore; what was the point of fighting to the death?
Zhao An wouldn’t allow them to fight. This headache-inducing palace intrigue meant she couldn’t side with either side; they were both her flesh and blood!

chapters.title: Chapter 1364 Bai Qingyang’s probing
paragraphs: Back home...

Zhao An had barely sat down when his mother, Zhao Xinlei, arrived, bringing with her a fragrant scent. Her slender, white arms embraced her son. "Xiao An, it seems like just yesterday you had so many children.
You must handle the children’s situation well. Mom knows you like to play, but play is play, children are innocent. Don’t just give birth and then abandon them.
That’s not good."
"Yes, Mom, I know what to do.
The children will take their surnames, it’s fine.
I will pay for their upbringing and give them the best education.
I will teach them principles; I will personally teach each of them, don’t worry."

Zhao An’s eyes flickered. He really needed to pay attention to the next generation’s education. At least his daughters couldn’t be left with other men; being able to handle it himself was the best option.
"Then Mom is relieved. I know what you’re doing."
A smile appeared in Zhao Xinlei’s beautiful eyes. Her son was good in every way, excelling at everything he did.

The only downside is his excessive lust. Fortunately, each of his son’s women is someone he has feelings for, and he knows how to maintain those relationships. Otherwise, if the women had problems, the harem would be in serious turmoil.
In fact, Zhao An has been arranging things like this recently. The kindergarten is already built.
Professional preschool teachers will be hired to teach there, and the primary and secondary schools are also ready.
As for how to raise them...
Zhao An hasn’t decided yet.
He plans to have his daughters study, and after they develop their own personalities, they can choose corresponding majors.
At the same time, he’ll memorize each daughter’s information, because he’ll definitely hand over the group to them to manage in the future.
If he can’t let them marry, then he’ll just devour them.
After chatting with his mother for a while...
Zhao An then received a message from Bai Qingyang, the eldest son of the Bai family, "Zhao An, the Huang family has split up."
"Oh, really?"
Zhao An pretended to be surprised, but he wasn’t surprised at all.
The Huang family patriarch was inherently biased. Only the man who could ensure the Huang family’s continuation was considered a true member; everyone else was merely a tool to be used.
There could only be one head of the family...
While the others appeared to be powerful, they were simply tools.
They all served the head of the family.
By the second or third generation, they were essentially distant relatives, essentially raised in a privileged position, forever bound to the family’s control, destined to become mere tools.
The Huang patriarch had already prepared his will, leaving everything in the family, including the group’s shares, to his grandson, bypassing even his son.
Choosing his grandson as head of the family wasn’t because his son wasn’t capable...
but because, relatively speaking, his grandson was more capable.
He understood the consequences of being the head of the family. A patriarch who was old and unwilling to relinquish power was detrimental to the family.
Huang Yu was still young, only in his thirties. Barring unforeseen circumstances, he had enough time to maintain the Huang family.
To this end, Old Master Huang even seized possessions belonging to his grandson Huang Meng and gave them to his eldest grandson, all to elevate him to the position.
This kind of obsession naturally made people resentful. The old man was perfectly fine while he was alive.
He had enough prestige and could keep everyone in check.
But who knew he would suddenly die, a death that caught everyone completely off guard.
Even with a will, would anyone accept it?
Yes, the law would.
That’s enough. Whether the family members acknowledged it or not was irrelevant.
Why do such ugly things happen in large families?

It’s simple. Their shares would vanish in the hands of the new family head, their wealth would shrink drastically, and as the head of the family, Huang Yu had many ways to make them relinquish their shares.
He could even use his power as family head to suppress disobedient members—after all, he was the head of the family!
"Hehe, they’re fighting like dogs over there, everyone trying to get a piece of the pie.
That Huang Yu guy’s got some skills; he’s holding onto the shipping industry tightly.
He’s dumped the other industries, letting the rest of the Huang family snatch them up in exchange for shares in the shipping company."
Bai Qingyang gave his old rival high praise; the man truly deserved the title of one of the Four Young Masters.
"Shipping isn’t so easy anymore, hehe."
Zhao An chuckled. Unexpected things can happen; if something goes wrong, the entire ship and its cargo are doomed.
The compensation alone would be enough to make a fortune. Generally, a shipping malpractice case can deduct one’s profits, not even counting maintenance costs and bribes.
"That’s true, hehe.
Do you have any designs on Huang Yu’s mother?"
Bai Qingyang knew Zhao An liked to play around with women.
And older women at that.
He wouldn’t mind letting Zhao An have a little encounter with Huang Yu, seduce someone’s mother. Huang Yu absolutely couldn’t tolerate this.
"Not interested."
Zhao An hung up the phone immediately after speaking. Even if he were interested, he wouldn’t say it directly.
Cooperating with the Bai family was good, but it was foolish to hand over leverage to others.
Bai Qingyang shrugged at Huang Meng in front of him. "He said he’s not interested."
"Would a cat not eat fish?"
A sinister smile appeared on Huang Meng’s scarred face, making him look like a cannibalistic demon.

If each person bets 100 million in cash, the cut would be 200 million, meaning they’d take 20 million.
This is clearly robbery, but the casino offers some services, like cigarettes and alcohol, and dealers—the service here is top-notch.
Anyway, as long as I don’t get involved in the gambling schemes and feuds, Las Vegas will provide the best service.
Essentially, they’re in the service industry.
If customers have fun, they’ll definitely come back.
Reputation is the most important thing.
As for poor people?
The world has no shortage of nouveau riche; it’s normal.
"How do you want to gamble?
You’re fucking dead!"
Beside Zhu Ran was a white man, seemingly a gambling consultant in Las Vegas, but actually a professional gambler who made his living by helping others gamble.
They were both seasoned gamblers, with a winning percentage.
If they couldn’t help their clients win, they wouldn’t survive; reputation mattered.
However, one thing was certain: they wouldn’t help their clients gamble against the casino.
There was no reason for them to lend a knife to the other side and let them kill them; that wasn’t going to happen.
"Then let’s go for the big games, traditional mahjong, one million as the base, two hundred thousand in winnings, extra for discarding the winning tile."
Zhao An said calmly, completely unconcerned about this kind of betting, and only had a few bodyguards with him.
Zhu Ran, of course, had bodyguards, and also a voluptuous, tall young woman.
However, there was still a faint handprint on her face; it seemed she hadn’t recovered from being slapped yesterday!
"Okay, but we’ll play Red Dragon Ghost."
The Red Dragon Ghost means that the Red Dragon can substitute for any other card, greatly accelerating the process of winning.
"Alright, hehe."
A strange smile flickered at the corner of Zhao An’s mouth, as if he were calculating something.
Zhu Ran suddenly shuddered, somewhat bewildered, not knowing what was happening.
When he realized what was going on, he broke out in a cold sweat.
He had mortgaged the family company to get a loan, just for a moment of pride?
If his family found out, he’d probably be torn to shreds!
He might even be fired, and then he’d be in big trouble!
He had no idea why he’d gotten so carried away; he seemed to be in a constant state of anger, unable to even think rationally.
At the beginning...
Zhao An intentionally let him win, allowing Zhu Ran to win several million.
Zhu Ran thought his luck had turned around and was overjoyed.
But Zhao An won it all back in no time, and within an hour, he had gambled away all the money he had borrowed.
This wasn’t just his money...
It was the company’s money, and it wasn’t a small amount.
A full 100 million yuan, all gone!
Less than an hour—no, it should be half an hour.
For the first half hour, Zhao An deliberately let him win!

chapters.title: Chapter 1374 Losing until you take your pants off
paragraphs: Seeing Zhu Ran’s pale face across from him...
Zhao An counted the money bill by bill, deliberately provoking Zhu Ran.
Zhu Ran’s eyes were red as he stared at the money.
"Heh, trash, want to play again?"
Zhao An said with a smile.
Zhu Ran stared at Zhao An without saying a word, wishing he could kill him and drink his blood.
He’d lost a hundred million. How was he going to explain this to his family?
He’d be lucky to escape with his life!
He might be expelled from the family, and then he’d be finished!
His old enemies would come knocking, and he’d die a horrible death!
Don’t say rich kids don’t bully others; when they do, they’re incredibly smug. What kind of rich person doesn’t bully others?
"How about I lend you some?"
Zhao An said.
Zhu Ran’s eyes lit up. "Okay, okay, lend me some, lend me some!"
Zhao An chuckled and pulled out several bundles of chips. "Wait, write an IOU first."
He clapped his hands, and the door opened. A portly, middle-aged white man walked in.
"Attorney Thomas, please ensure the legality of these IOUs," Zhao An said, pointing to the ones Zhu Ran had written.
"Sure, no problem."
Thomas was a lawyer at the law firm and also Zhao An’s private lawyer.
In the United States, private lawyers often work at the law firm in addition to their private practice.
This doesn’t conflict with their daily work.
They only work when their employers need them, earning two salaries—it couldn’t be better!
With the money in hand, Zhu Ran perked up again, but looking at the mahjong tiles, he hesitated...
Zhao An’s luck was too good; he dared not play mahjong.
Zhao An pulled out a deck of cards he’d prepared beforehand and said, "Zhu Ran, how about we play Texas Hold’em?"
Looking at the money in his hand, then at the cards, Zhu Ran nodded and said, "Okay!"
Like mahjong, these were specialized gambling tools...
Zhao An was essentially gambling with Zhu Ran while looking at the deck.
However, to prevent Zhu Ran from being tricked...

Zhao An let Zhu Ran keep winning. Soon, Zhu Ran had a pile of money in front of him, not only winning back the 30 million he’d lost earlier, but also almost all of the 50 million he’d lost during the day.
Zhao An remained calm until he got a particularly unlucky hand. Zhu Ran got three Aces, a triple...
Zhao An, on the other hand, got two, three, and five of different suits.
At this point, Zhao An knew the time was right. He glanced at the ecstatic Zhu Ran...
Zhao An smiled.
What is a truly unlucky hand? This is a truly unlucky hand. You might not encounter such a hand even in a thousand hands. Similarly, if you didn’t know your opponent had a triple...
Even with such a hand, it’s a losing proposition. Only a shameless cheater like Zhao An would smile like a sly fox upon seeing such a hand.
Seeing Zhao An staring intently at him, Zhu Ran quickly suppressed his smile and said, "Your turn. How much are you betting?"
Zhao An tentatively threw in a 1, and Zhu Ran called without hesitation. He didn’t dare bet too much, cautiously raising the stakes little by little.
The two went from 10,000 to 100,000, then to 1 million, until finally all the money on the table was bet.
The hope was beautiful, but the ending was cruel. When the cards were revealed, Zhu Ran’s face turned green.
Zhu Ran’s eyes widened. "Impossible, impossible! How dare you call with such a weak hand?"
He stared at Zhao An, suspecting for the first time that Zhao An was cheating.
Zhao An chuckled, "I wasn’t planning on betting.
But seeing you bet bigger and bigger...
And your smile is so wide...
I guessed you might be a leopard...
And a big leopard at that, otherwise you wouldn’t dare be so reckless!"
Zhu Ran, still puzzled, asked, "But with so much money, aren’t you afraid of losing?"
Zhao An shook his head, "It’s a huge sum for you, but for me, it’s not even enough for a meal. What do I have to worry about?"
Hearing Zhao An say this, Zhu Ran was speechless. Yes, it was a huge sum for him, but for Zhao An, it was just groceries.
Watching Zhao An put the money away, Zhu Ran gritted his teeth and said, "I want to gamble again!"
Zhao An nonchalantly handed Zhu Ran the paper, and Zhu Ran gritted his teeth and borrowed another ten million.
Zhao An gave the money to Zhu Ran without hesitation.
Three hours later.
The two faced each other in silence, neither sleepy. One was blinded by losses, the other too excited to sleep.
You see, Zhao An was wealthy.
But he had never tried this method of winning money before.
*Clatter*...
Zhao An put down his cards. For the past three hours, Zhu Ran had kept asking to change the cards.
Zhao An had agreed to each request.
But no matter what, he always lost.
Either he won very little, or he lost everything, including his pants.
Zhu Ran finally came to his senses. Seeing the stack of IOUs in front of Zhao An, his face darkened.
"Zhu Ran, it’s time to settle the accounts!"
Zhao An said with a smile.
Seeing Zhao An’s still warm smile, Zhu Ran suddenly felt a chill.
"Brother, how much do I owe?"
Zhu Ran’s voice trembled.
He couldn’t remember how many IOUs he had written, but five million, ten million, it seemed like a lot. His legs were shaking.
Zhao An smiled and nodded, glancing at the nervous Zhu Ran. "Zhu Ran, it doesn’t seem like much, just over eight hundred million."
Zhu Ran’s mouth twisted in disbelief. His jaw dropped, staring at Zhao An incredulously. How could he possibly owe so much? Over eight hundred million! Good heavens, how could he possibly repay that?
Zhao An still smiled and said, "Zhu Ran, is it easy to repay the money now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1375 They started pressing for repayment.
paragraphs: Zhu Ran was dumbfounded. How could he repay the money? What could he possibly use? He had no way of repaying it.
He looked at Zhao An with pleading eyes, unable to utter a single word.
Zhao An sneered, "Zhu Ran, weren’t you planning not to repay the money?"
Zhu Ran saw the stack of IOUs in Zhao An’s hand and hurriedly shook his head, saying, "Repay, repay.
But brother, I don’t have that much money!"
Zhao An smiled and said, "You can go home and ask!
It’s only right for Zhu Ran to repay his debts; I believe you understand that!"
What is a devil like...?
What is Zhao An like now?
The thought of going home to ask for the money made Zhu Ran’s face turn deathly pale. Although the Zhu family was wealthy,
compared to the powerful families who had set the price, they were nothing.
Forget whether the Zhu family would repay the money; even if they were willing, it would be a painful ordeal.
They can’t possibly come up with hundreds of millions in liquid assets. Their assets are fixed and unrealized, not actually that much money.
"Zhao An, my family really doesn’t have that much money!"
Zhu Ran pleaded, "Can’t you not tell them?"
Zhao An laughed, "If you don’t have money, what are you gambling for?!
Don’t tell me you’re trying to get something for nothing!
Do you think I’m that easy to bully?"
Zhu Ran froze, even a fool could tell...
If Zhao An had that much money, he must be an ordinary person.
Zhao An continued, "By the way, I can sue you. I have an IOU; this is legal debt collection!
The Zhu family will definitely be happy to pay back the money. Money doesn’t matter, but reputation comes first.

By the way, don’t just talk to the Zhu family. Even if you gamble in Las Vegas, the casinos here have the right to collect my gambling debts. Hehe, when they come to collect, it won’t be so easy for me to talk to them."
Zhu Ran swayed, realizing what would happen if his family found out.
Needless to say, he’d be expelled from the family register.
His legs went weak, and he could no longer sit still, kneeling before Zhao An.
Zhao An didn’t even blink, asking, "Oh, Zhu Ran, what do you mean by this?"
Zhu Ran lowered his head helplessly, saying, "I don’t have that much money. Can you please be magnanimous and let me off the hook?
I’m sorry, I was wrong just now. I shouldn’t have been so rude to you. I apologize; it’s all my fault.
I’m sorry!"
"Hahaha, are you an idiot?!
Hundreds of millions in debt, forgiven with a single word? Are you out of your mind?!
It’s okay, we can take it slow. We can always go to court.
If you can’t pay, then the Zhu family will pay. If they don’t pay, then we’ll send you to jail!"
Zhao An’s smile was unusually sinister.
"Sir, he can’t leave here without paying back the money.
I guarantee with my professional expertise that he must fulfill the debt agreement."
Attorney Thomas, playing the villain, stepped in to intimidate the other party.
Zhu Ran, already kneeling there, kowtowed repeatedly, pleading, "Zhao An, please let me go, please!"
Zhao An smiled; that was more like it, exactly the attitude he wanted.
Zhao An smiled and said, "Zhu Ran, I’ll show you a way!"
Zhu Ran looked at Zhao An excitedly, "Tell me, tell me, I’ll do whatever you want."
Zhao An glanced at the house and said, "Your wife seems quite beautiful!"
Zhu Ran nodded, looking at Zhao An with confusion.
Feng Nan’s expression changed, her face turning pale as she looked at her husband.
She seemed to have guessed what he was going to do; he clearly wanted to use her to pay off the debt!
Zhao An finally smiled genuinely. "Speaking of which, do you have anything valuable left in this room?"
Zhu Ran looked at Zhao An, puzzled. Everything in the room had been used to pay off debts; what valuable could he possibly have?
Seeing Zhu Ran’s blockheadedness...
Zhao An shook his head. "Zhu Ran, you’ve read ’The White-Haired Girl,’ right? There’s a line that goes, ’If you have no money, use Xi’er to pay off your debts!’"
Zhao An finally revealed his true intentions. Zhu Ran burst into laughter, finally understanding Zhao An’s goal.
So Zhao An was after his wife! No wonder he said he’d use things to pay off the debts.
A surge of anger rushed to Zhu Ran’s head. He jumped to his feet, pointing a finger at Zhao An, and said, "You...you!
...You actually..."
Zhu Ran was speechless with rage.
Zhao An was unfazed by Zhu Ran’s anger...
Instead, he held up the IOU and counted, "Ten thousand, twenty thousand, thirty thousand..."
By the time he reached one hundred thousand, Zhu Ran was speechless, his sudden burst of courage gone.
With each number Zhao An uttered, his courage dwindled, until finally, his back, which had just straightened, bent back down again.
"Zhao An, I beg you, please let me go.
You’re so rich, you don’t need this little bit of money!"
Zhu Ran pleaded.
Zhao An coldly snorted, "Did I tell you to stand up?"
Zhao An had already seen through him; this was a coward. If he were the kind of guy who would spill blood...
Zhao An wouldn’t be forcing him like this.
Unfortunately, Zhu Ran wasn’t that kind of person.
The fact that he could kneel down was enough to tell.
And since he had bent down once, he would definitely bend down again.
Sure enough, Zhu Ran knelt down again.
Zhao An, holding the IOU for 100,000 yuan, said, "How about 100,000 yuan, Zhu Ran? That’s not a low price.
You know, hiring a prostitute only costs 2,000 yuan.
Even a virgin would only cost around 10,000 yuan. I’m being quite generous."

chapters.title: Chapter 1376 Your wife is worthless.
paragraphs: Zhu Ran’s face was deathly pale...
Staring at the 100,000 yuan IOU, he didn’t know what to do.
He turned to look at his wife, who was also pale-faced, shaking her head slightly.
"If she spent one night with you, would these debts be settled?"
Feng Nan’s heart pounded, and tears streamed down her face uncontrollably.
Although she didn’t love Zhu Ran, she still had some feelings for him.
The reason she cried was because she had been treated like merchandise and sold off!
"Zhu Ran, are you even a man?!
You actually used your wife to pay off debts!"
"What are you crying about!
All these years you’ve taken money from me to give to your parents, have I ever said anything?!
Damn it, she’s not a virgin, stop whining, is it so hard to get fucked?!"
Zhu Ran was also furious; he knew his wife’s true nature.
She was essentially just a woman greedy for money and pleasure. If she weren’t somewhat pretty, he would have kicked her to the curb long ago.
*Slap!*
Feng Nan slapped Zhu Ran across the face. "You beast!
You’re not even a man!"
Zhu Ran froze...
A surge of anger rushed to his head. This shameless woman actually hit him! How dare she!
How could he ever face anyone again? How could he ever stand on his own two feet in society!
Just as he was about to retaliate...
Zhao An’s words arrived, "Heh, your wife’s cunt is inlaid with gold and diamonds.
You borrowed US dollars from me, idiot, look carefully!"
Zhu Ran’s face paled. He hurriedly checked the IOU, and sure enough, it said US dollars.
His head was spinning. He almost fainted. That’s billions of dollars! Even if he sold everything he owned, he couldn’t scrape together that much money!
Even the Zhu family would have to sell all their assets to come up with that amount.
But the Zhu family would never do that for him; he was completely finished!
"Your wife is only worth 100,000. Remember, 100,000.
You can get out of here. I’ll give you three days.
If you can’t give me a satisfactory answer in three days, I’ll show you why flowers bloom so red!"
Zhao An tossed over a 100,000 IOU, then another 10,000. "Heh, this is for your lunchbox. Don’t die, or I’ll make sure your deeds are known throughout the Zhu family!"
Zhao An wouldn’t push people too hard; too much pressure could lead to extremes.
Unexpected things might happen then, and although he could control it, the consequences would be troublesome.
So, giving the other party a glimmer of hope, without utter despair, was the most effective and easiest way to control the situation.
After saying this, Zhao An walked over and grabbed Feng Nan, leering, "Hehe, good sister-in-law, I’ll take good care of you.
There’s no future with this good-for-nothing. Serve me well, and you’ll get your rewards.
Hahaha!"
"No, don’t touch me!"
Feng Nan wanted to appear strong; if she just gave in, she’d easily be looked down upon.
It was best to show some strength, otherwise, being looked down upon would lower her value in the future.
Men are all like that; what they can’t have is the best, and once they have it, they don’t cherish it!
Slap!

Zhao An slapped Feng Nan so hard she was stunned. "If you don’t agree, then go be a prostitute to pay off your debts, you son of a bitch! You think you’re a virgin? A used slut, you bastard! Come with me!"
He left without even looking at Feng Nan.
Feng Nan was completely stunned; she hadn’t known Zhao An could be so ruthless.
